purpose: Separate effects of the implemented observation objective from finite neural optimization, within an explicitly different fixed polynomial model class.
inputs: Read-only shared reviewer-sensitivity-2026-10-15 input manifest and its twenty hashed NPZ files; no historical training checkpoints.
loss: Exact discrete six-term revision_core.objective_terms, including mean factors, periodic face-averaged diffusion, 256-point smoothness support, original normalized spatial tests and optional full space-time weak trapezoidal tests. Baseline computation uses float64; neural training remains float32.
weight_configs: Read shared sensitivity MANIFEST.json, deduplicate identical variant/weights/weak_variant, retain core/dense/joint and optional weak phases. No weight selection by true closure error.
linear_solver: Per-term QR compression of augmented normalized [A,-b]; weighted stacking; column equilibration and SVD least squares, no added ridge. Report rank, singular values, condition numbers, loss and stationarity.

least_squares_certificate.rank_deficiency: Explicitly flagged even when the minimum-norm SVD result satisfies stationarity; no uniqueness claim.

positive_diffusion.solver: QR-whitened convex quadratic program, SLSQP with analytic gradient and linear inequalities; continuous quadratic-D minimum at endpoints and interior vertex supplies additional separating cuts when required.
positive_diffusion.rule: Optimizer success alone is insufficient. Preserve status, exact continuous minimum, active-set multipliers, primal feasibility, stationarity, complementarity and primal-dual gap. Failed attempts are explicit and not silently retried by changing the scientific protocol.

main_configurations: All 34 shared-manifest configurations, twenty inputs, observed-feature/observed-target arm, two constraint arms: 1360 coefficient fits.
oracle_count: 6 levels x 2 cases x 5 seeds x 2 clipping arms x 4 target/feature arms x 3 fixed configurations x 2 constraints = 2880 diagnostic fits; repeated zero-noise fields do not add samples.
oracle_definition: A is built from the selected feature field, b from the selected target field, while tests/support/anchor/regularizer remain fixed. Space-weak target uses projected central time differences; strong/mass use corresponding time differences; rollout target uses U[n+1]-U[n]. Full space-time target uses the selected field against differentiated temporal tests. Clean fields are synthetic oracle information, never a deployable observed-data method.

noise_curve.coupling: Reuse the shared clean_u and seed-specific numpy default_rng Gaussian draw, scale by level*std(clean_u), exactly reproduce the shared noise3 field before using additional levels.
noise_curve.zero_noise: Original observation helper does not clip zero-noise data; clipped and unclipped diagnostic fields coincide and are not independent replicates.
noise_curve.configuration_rule: Only the three fixed oracle_configurations: default, drop_strong, space_time_weak. These were selected for mechanism coverage before oracle results, not by true error. CLI may select a predeclared subset for resource staging, recording the selection.

evaluation: 256 uniform states on the case interval; true D/R only in post-fit evaluation, plus observed enclosure metrics, exact quadratic diffusion minimum, R(0), R(0.01), full coefficients and per-component losses. No closure truth in fitting, hyperparameter choice or solver stopping.
validation: Matrix residual loss versus direct revision_core objective_terms for random coefficients, both weak variants
Coefficient gradient versus Torch autograd and centered finite differences
Convex constrained test with independent scalar optimum
Actual input hash and shared noise3 reconstruction
Failure preservation and complete result cardinality
interpretation: Global optimum is within the seven-coefficient class, not the neural hypothesis class. Target variance amplification alone is not proof of population bias; finite sample oracle contrasts remain descriptive unless additional noise replication or an analytical expectation argument is provided.
